scope: mechanical copper identification, grading, separation, and sale comparison

workflow.title: Identify copper-bearing item
workflow.instruction: Determine whether the material is bare copper, insulated wire, bus bar, tubing, winding, connector material, or a mixed assembly.

workflow.title: Verify base metal
workflow.instruction: Use visible cross-section, magnet response where useful, weight/context, and buyer-grade rules rather than assuming copper from surface color.

workflow.title: Preserve grade
workflow.instruction: Keep clean bare copper separate from soldered, painted, tinned, insulated, or mixed copper-bearing material.

workflow.title: Compare processing options
workflow.instruction: For insulated wire or mixed assemblies, compare the buyer's as-is price against the expected clean-copper yield and labor required.

workflow.title: Mechanical preparation
workflow.instruction: Use safe mechanical stripping or disassembly only when it improves net value. Do not burn insulation.

workflow.title: Weigh clean fractions
workflow.instruction: Record net weights by grade so Scrap Radar can apply the appropriate local or estimated price.

workflow.title: Time-value check
workflow.instruction: Use Worth My Time? to decide whether additional cleaning or stripping earns enough per minute to continue.
